description_en: Changes the endpoint or port number of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance
description_zh: 修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的连接地址和端口
name: ModifyDBInstanceConnectionString

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the new endpoint. Specify the endpoint in the `<prefix>.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com` format. The prefix must be 8 to 40 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters and digits. It must start with a lowercase letter.

You must specify one of the NewConnectionString and Port parameters
parameters.help_zh:
新连接地址的前缀。实例的连接地址格式为：`<前缀>.redis.rds.aliyuncs.com`。地址前缀需由小写英文字母、数字组成，但必须以小写字母开头，长度为8~40个字符。
请求参数NewConnectionString和Port两者中必须传入一项
parameters.name: new_connection_string

parameters.help_en: The current endpoint of the instance
parameters.name: current_connection_string

parameters.help_en:
The port number of the instance. Valid values: 1024 to 65535.

You must specify one of the NewConnectionString and Port parameters
parameters.help_zh:
实例的服务端口号，取值范围：1~65535。
请求参数NewConnectionString和Port两者中必须传入一项
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the endpoint. Valid values:

Private: internal network
Public: Internet
parameters.help_zh:
地址的网络类型，取值：
Private：专有网络。
Public：公网
parameters.name: ip_type
